answer: Bind every earning identity to one hardware enclave attestation, so a farm spawning a thousand clones still docks at the same wharf: the ledger allows only one paid identity per enclave key, and a second registration under that key is rejected. Clones can whisper new names, but without a fresh enclave they share one slot and one payout, while each extra enclave costs more than it earns, turning the sybil spiral into a loss-making loop.
